maddeler.e:
تستحثوا (form X)
# تَسْتَحِثُّوا (tastaḥiṯṯū) /tas.ta.ħiθ.θuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# تُسْتَحَثُّوا (tustaḥaṯṯū) /tus.ta.ħaθ.θuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
